theme_id: # Hand-made themes (2026-10-28, by request): entities the Wikipedia linker can't produce (a concept like 'data center' is too weakly related to the countries in a question). graph_build writes them as theme:<id> entity nodes (entity_type theme); seeds/theme_links.csv attaches them to markets by one reasoning pass, seeds/theme_exposures.csv to issuers; `factors` = the factors a linked question is relevant to (factors.RULES, channel theme).
